scope: Historical general reporting rules, not a verified FY2025 API codebook
findings: Results associated with ten or fewer students may be withheld, including percentage cells and complementary cells that would reveal them. A tested denominator above ten does not guarantee every outcome cell is publishable.
Extremely high/low percentages may be released as >98 or <2. This does not specify integer rounding for all ordinary percentages.
